Nearhuman is an AI research and product company in Bristol. We build efficient AI that runs on everyday devices, and new ways for people to work with it. Explore Nearhuman Research & engineering Discover what’s near Bristol, United Kingdom The company A company built to invent the future. We’re creating new methods, tools and interfaces to change how people use technology. Starting with AI that runs on physical devices themselves, with no reliance on the cloud. We’re developing new methods to make machines intelligent. We bring research and engineering together to carry new ideas through to working technology. Live in Bristol with Dott Innovate UK Frontier AI Backed by SFC Capital How we work Working with Backed by What we build Products from our research. Rosabel MDP BNN research Live pilot in Bristol Our first edge-AI camera module, designed from the ground up to be retrofitted onto e-scooters and e-bikes. It runs its AI on the vehicle itself, and it is live on Bristol’s streets today in a pilot with Dott. Visit scootrr.com ↗ Our approach From research to working technology. Research and engineering happen side by side. We develop and test ideas in hardware and software, carrying what we learn into the next build.
